## History

Myra Murray, whose maiden name was Corey, belonged to a family from [Kettlebridge](../codex/places.md#kettlebridge) known for their handsome appearance. Fourteen years prior, she purchased a black satin gown for her daughter's wedding. Following her passing, Miss Winifred and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to discuss her upcoming funeral.

## Quotes

> "I might be dressed in it for my burial, Aunty, but I shall enjoy myself in it beforehand."
>
> — Myra Murray — [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P2](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0002)

> "whereas I invariably despised doing it in the autumn. Thank goodness, I shall escape it this year."
>
> — Myra Murray — [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P5](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0005)

> "Well, if such is the case, I am grateful that all the preserving has been completed, and I am spared from undergoing the autumn house-cleaning. Spring house-cleaning was always to my liking"
>
> — Myra Murray — [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P5](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0005)

> "I’ll keep a stiff upper lip to my journey’s end"
>
> — Myra Murray — [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P8](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0008)
